interface.title: Parallax · Scientific claim stress testing
interface.field: Cell biology / high-content microscopy (cell viability and compound treatment assays, live-cell imaging)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and validation of results: checking how far a microscopy-derived treatment effect can be trusted before reporting it
interface.what_it_is_for: Link microscopy images to a plate or evidence map and an independent endpoint, measure a treatment effect, challenge it with QC exclusion, leave-one-replicate-out, label permutation and cross-modality comparison, return a cautious verdict with exportable evidence, and separately observe a microscope video on its own without a plate map.

data.note: Plate run: bbbc005-in-focus.png, bbbc005-ground-truth.png, heldout-focused-f1.jpg, heldout-blurred-f35.jpg, plate_map.csv and plate_reader.csv, using the 'Brightfield vs Fluorescent Staining' (Caco-2) profile. The images are not real Caco-2 data: they are synthetic BBBC005 images and FocusNet held-out focus examples, assigned to Caco-2 Camptothecin/control rows by the fixture plate map. A second run used the Classical model and left out heldout-blurred-f35.jpg on purpose. Video run: incucyte-growth-s1.mp4. Both downloaded templates (plate-map.csv, plate-reader.csv) are built in. All QC results come from these few fixture images, which are reused across rows, so every control unit has the same values and so does every treated unit. All 6 units failed QC, so the QC-adjusted effect could not be computed and leave-one-replicate-out is degenerate.

tree.general: Decide whether an apparent treatment effect seen in microscopy is trustworthy, and describe what a time-lapse recording shows
tree.specific: Stress-test the 'Camptothecin 6 uM' claim as set up under the Caco-2 (Brightfield vs Fluorescent Staining) profile, using four synthetic BBBC005/FocusNet fixture images reused across rows (not real Caco-2 data), against QC, replicates, label permutation and the independent endpoint; observe an Incucyte growth video (seen in one run only; the replay stalled at 2%)

A QC-adjusted effect value: all 6 evidence units failed QC, so 'After QC exclusions' showed 'Not available'
Robust, Replicate-sensitive or Underpowered verdicts: these test files did not produce them
Video event timeline with timestamped events and cell tracks: the Incucyte fixture is a sparse growth sequence, so tracking and events were skipped on purpose
